blurb: JJ Helicopters offers helicopter tours around Los Angeles, flight training for pilot licenses using Robinson R22 and R44 helicopters, and aerial photography flights. Tours include various scenic routes such as the Deluxe LA Tour and shorter chopper rides over specific areas. Flight training includes private pilot, commercial pilot, certified flight instructor, and instrument rating courses.
